title: Deep-learning histology features add to colorectal cancer lymph node metastasis prediction
summary: Deep-learning embeddings of small tumor patches were clustered by k-means and the clusters that added value were combined with six clinicopathologic variables in a logistic regression model. The machine-learned features carried independent signal for lymph node metastasis (AUROC 0.638) and improved prediction in an external validation set (likelihood ratio test).
ai_technology: Deep-learning patch embeddings clustered by k-means and added to logistic regression

evidence.tested: External validation set tested by likelihood ratio test.
evidence.unknown: Modest discrimination (AUROC 0.638); retrospective; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning embeddings of tumor histology supplied the extra predictive features.
